name: Core Traits Panel
description: Well-characterised appearance, athletic and nutrition traits from single well-replicated variants. Migrated verbatim from the app's original hardcoded traits module.
disclaimer: Trait predictions are simplified single-variant heuristics for educational purposes only and are not medical, diagnostic, or ancestry advice.

variants.label: Eye Color
variants.description: HERC2 gene variant is the primary determinant of blue vs. brown eye color

genotypes.effect: GG genotype strongly associated with brown eyes
AG genotype associated with variable eye color
AA genotype strongly associated with blue eyes

variants.label: Eye Color (modifier)
variants.description: OCA2 variant modifies eye color determination

variants.label: Red Hair
variants.description: MC1R gene variant strongly associated with red hair and fair skin

genotypes.effect: Homozygous MC1R variant, associated with red hair

genotypes.prediction: Unlikely red hair from this variant

variants.label: Muscle Fiber Type
variants.description: ACTN3 gene determines alpha-actinin-3 presence in fast-twitch muscle fibers

genotypes.effect: CC genotype: functional alpha-actinin-3 protein, favors fast-twitch muscle
CT genotype: intermediate muscle fiber composition
TT genotype: alpha-actinin-3 deficiency, favors slow-twitch/endurance

variants.label: Caffeine Metabolism
variants.description: CYP1A2 enzyme activity determines how quickly you metabolize caffeine

genotypes.effect: AA genotype: rapid caffeine metabolism via CYP1A2
CC genotype: slow caffeine metabolism, higher sensitivity

variants.label: Alcohol Flush Reaction
variants.description: ALDH2 variant causes acetaldehyde accumulation and facial flushing after alcohol

genotypes.effect: AG genotype: reduced ALDH2 activity, flush reaction
AA genotype: very low ALDH2 activity, severe flush

variants.label: Bitter Taste Perception
variants.description: TAS2R38 gene determines sensitivity to bitter compounds like PTC and PROP

variants.label: Bitter Taste Perception (modifier)
variants.description: Additional TAS2R38 variant contributing to bitter taste sensitivity

variants.label: Bitter Taste Perception (modifier 2)
variants.description: Third TAS2R38 variant for complete bitter taste haplotype

variants.label: Cilantro/Coriander Aversion
variants.description: OR6A2 olfactory receptor variant associated with perceiving cilantro as soapy

genotypes.effect: CA genotype: partial soapy taste sensitivity
AA genotype: OR6A2 variant associated with soapy taste
